messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

First, the Manager checks the open leads. Afterwards, he selects the top five ones. He then tells his Sales Assistant to call the contact person of the leads. The Sales Assistant calls each customer. If someone is interested, he sends a note to the Manager. The Manager then processes the lead. Otherwise, he calls the next customer.

  <bpmn:process id="LeadProcessingProcess" name="Lead Processing Process" isExecutable="true">

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_1">

      </bpmn:startEvent>

        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_No</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SendNote" name="Send note to Manager">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_ToManager</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_Continue" name="Next Customer">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_No</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_NoteSent" name="Note Sent">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ToManager</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessLead" name="Process the lead">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromSub</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_CheckLeads" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckLeads" targetRef="Task_SelectTopFive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectTopFive" targetRef="Task_TellAssistant" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_TellAssistant" targetRef="SubProcess_CallCustomers" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_1" sourceRef="SubStart_1" targetRef="Task_CallCustomer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_CallCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_Interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_SendNote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="SubEnd_Continue" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_ToManager" sourceRef="Task_SendNote" targetRef="SubEnd_NoteSent" />
    <!-- Note: In a strict BPMN loop, we would use a multi-instance or a specific loop structure. 
         Here, to represent "Otherwise he calls the next customer" within the context of the description 
         where the Manager processes the lead *after* the assistant sends a note, we model the SubProcess 
         as the interaction phase. The flow from SubProcess to Task_ProcessLead implies the completion 
         of the relevant interaction (the note being sent). -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromSub" sourceRef="SubProcess_CallCustomers" targetRef="Task_ProcessLead" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProcessLead" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />
